summary: Matched pear-shaped lab-grown diamond studs in solid 14K white or yellow gold, with E–F colour and VS clarity or better. Choose 1–4 ct total diamond weight per pair.
description:
Two carefully matched pear-shaped lab-grown diamonds bring an elongated point of light to each ear. Each pair is selected for complementary shape, proportions and brilliance.

Choose approximately 1.00 CTW for $1,200 CAD, 2.00 CTW for $1,900 CAD (40% off), 3.00 CTW for $3,100 CAD (30% off), or 4.00 CTW for $4,200 CAD (30% off). Prices are per pair, before taxes; carat weights are the total for both earrings.

Available in solid 14K white or yellow gold, with E–F diamond colour and VS clarity or better. All weights are approximate. The necklace in the styling video is sold separately.
